patchName: Patch 2.2.23 — Popol and Kupa Revamp (Original Server)
source: MLBB Plus local data, updated to Patch 2.2.23 (Nov 11, 2026 Original Server). Hero base stats, titles, roles, skills and lore cross-checked vs MLBB in-game patch notes (Kazuki Official / mlbb.tools / timesaver.gg mirror), MLBB Wiki (Fandom) hero stats tables, and MLBBGuides / MLBB Draft hero DB (Nov 2026). Win/Pick/Ban rates are Nov 2026 community tracker estimates (MLBBGuides Nov 1 2026 + MLBBDex 2.2.23 tier list) — they shift daily, treat as tier guidance not live ranked data. New heroes Obsidia (130), Sora (131), Marcel (132), Hirara (133) are 2025-2026 additions included in 133 roster. Dori (Advance Server 2.2.30) is NOT in Original Server 2.2.23, so not included.

patchChanges.detail: Full revamp: Popol can now ride Kupa. New Passive Biting Cold, S1 Icefield Sprint / Alpha Assault, S2 Kupa Help Me / Surprise Attack, S3 We Are Icefield Predators (mount form with CC immunity).
Passive: Orb consumption now heals 20 (+3*Level) (+20% PA). Ult CD 44-28s -> 60-44s, HP Regen on Basic during Ult removed, Enhanced Basic 30-60 (+100%) -> 100-200 (+70%), +30 MS while active.
S1 and S2 damage increased. S2 extra Basic Attack damage 30-45 (+30%) -> 60-90 (+40%).
S1 range increased, S2 minion/creep detection, Ult Light form debuff immunity -> CC immunity.
S1 slow -> removes boot MS effect, S2 minion/creep detection.
S1 PA Bonus 60% -> 75%, S2 PA Bonus 30% -> 50%.
S1 PA Bonus 90%->20% base, 20%->10% sustained (NERF), S2 detection improved, Ult Lightwheel 40->50, MS 20%->30% (BUFF).
S2 Growth 9->12, Total MP Bonus 45%->35%, Ult 400-650->350-500 base, 80%->70% Total MP.
Passive Basic Attack bonus 30%->15%, S2 HP Threshold no longer stacks.
Optimized indicator for max separation between Seimei Umbrella and Kagura. No damage change.

matchupData.source: MLBB Meta Analyser (Moonton GMS-derived ranked data) with MLBBHub direct-counter fallback
matchupData.coverage: 133 of 133 heroes have sourced entries in all three categories: 4-5 favorable matchups, 4-5 best measured allies, and 3-5 toughest matchups.
matchupData.method: Favorable matchups and best measured allies use the source CSV top-five counter and synergy lists. Toughest matchups are derived by reversing favorable-counter edges and ranking by weighted appearances (5 to 1). For the 43 heroes with fewer than three reverse edges, the top three direct ranked counter picks from MLBBHub are used instead. Placeholder IDs/names are excluded. These are statistical associations, not guarantees.
matchupData.sourceNotes: MLBB Meta Analyser is a third-party project that reports extracting ranked data from Moonton GMS and refreshing daily. MLBBHub per-hero pages publish ranked counter picks with win-rate advantage and were used for 43 low-coverage counter lists. MLCounters and MLBB.gg were consulted as secondary reference sites; no relationship was filled from generic role assumptions.

matchupDataset.sourceDataBasis: Moonton Game Management System ranked data

method.favorableMatchups: Top five counter_1..counter_5 from the source for each hero.
method.bestMeasuredAllies: Top five synergy_1..synergy_5 from the source for each hero.
method.toughestMatchups: Reverse index of source counter picks; ranked by weighted appearances (5 points for rank 1 through 1 point for rank 5), top five per hero. For 43 heroes with fewer than three reverse edges, use the top three direct MLBBHub ranked counter picks (pages updated Nov 17-20, 2026).

matchupDataset.note: All 133 heroes have sourced entries in all three categories. Favorable-matchup and ally lists contain 4-5 entries after excluding unresolved placeholders. Toughest-matchup lists contain 3-5 entries; MLBBHub direct ranked counters supplement low-coverage reverse-index results.
